sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Lightning Release, Earth Release

system.description:
You mold clay, earth or another inorganic earthen substance into a sphere housing destruction. Select a point you can see in range as you throw this blast bomb to that point and it detonates forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creatures is able to resist this jutsu’s effects

Success: Affected creatures take 3d6 force or poison damage.

Failure: Affected creatures take 5d6 force or poison damage and are Dazed.

Critical Failure: Affected creatures take 7d6 force damage and are Dazed and Staggered.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of points you can target by +1. Creatures caught in more than one explosion only makes a single saving throw by takes a -1 penalty for every explosion radius they are in beyond the first.
